_note: Pictures behind the alarm editor's game and sound tiles (UX.7, the user 2026-10-02: AI-made, cute pastel anime, filling the tile with the name on a pill). One shared style so the ten match. Built files go to app/src/main/assets/tiles/<id>.webp.
style: Cute pastel anime-style illustration for a mobile game button background. Soft rounded shapes, gentle cel shading, bright but soft pastel colours on a light cream background, warm morning light. Wide banner composition: the main objects sit on the left and right, with calmer, simpler space in the centre where a label will go. No people, no characters, no words, no logos, no watermark text.

tiles.label: Game: Rin picks
tiles.subject: A cheerful mix of little game items: four small glossy square buttons in red, blue, yellow and green, a pink cup with a small yellow ball, wooden alphabet blocks, and tiny sparkles.

tiles.label: Game: Pads
tiles.subject: Four big glossy rounded square game buttons in red, blue, yellow and green, softly glowing as if being pressed in order, with little light sparkles.

tiles.label: Game: Cups
tiles.subject: Three pink upside-down cups on a wooden table, a small yellow ball peeking out from under one, with soft swirl trails showing the cups being shuffled.

tiles.label: Game: Speak
tiles.subject: Colourful wooden alphabet blocks and floating cute speech bubbles, with soft sound-wave lines, as if someone is repeating a sentence out loud. Letters only on the blocks, no readable words.

tiles.label: Game: None
tiles.subject: A single big round pastel pink button on a soft cream surface, simple and calm, with a few faint sparkles.

tiles.label: Sound: Rin picks
tiles.subject: Floating musical notes in many pastel colours around a small open music box, with tiny sparkles.

tiles.label: Sound: Magic morning
tiles.subject: A magical morning: a sparkly star-tipped wand, a small open spell book with glowing pages, purple and gold stars and sparkles drifting in the air.

tiles.label: Sound: Sweet bistro
tiles.subject: A cute pastel patisserie table in a little Parisian bistro: macarons, a strawberry cupcake, wrapped candies and a small coffee cup with a heart in the foam.

tiles.label: Sound: Arcade morning
tiles.subject: Retro arcade game items in pastel pixel-art style: pixel hearts, shiny coins, a small arcade joystick and a little game cartridge.

tiles.label: Sound: Forest morning
tiles.subject: A fresh morning in a forest: green leaves, small wild flowers, a little bird on a branch and soft sun rays through the trees by a stream.

tiles.label: Sound: Beep
tiles.subject: A classic twin-bell alarm clock in pastel pink, ringing, with simple curved sound-wave lines around it.
